measurement_use: Emergency communication readiness rating for the current operating-shift review
rating_scale: 1 to 5, where 5 means fully confident that emergency messages are received and understood
reporting_rule: Publish a company-wide readiness result only from current-cycle responses after every shift meets the minimum completed-response threshold.
authorized_actions: Add the eligible current-cycle candidates needed to balance the participant pool.
Invite only the newly added current-cycle participant token IDs.
Keep prior-cycle and unmapped responses outside the current readiness calculation.
Report collection status instead of a readiness result while any shift remains below threshold.
